Does `eofcreate` do any verification and when? 2. In txcreate `validates the initcode container and all its subcontainers recursively`. when is this done? And as txcreate has access to tx initcodes, does those get validated? 1. not EOF validation, because this code was already validated when factory contract was deployed. 2. this is done by TXCREATE instruction after loading initcontainer from transaction and charging EIP-3860 charge for it There're some new thoughts about exact order of checks in TXCREATE https://github.com/ethereum/evmone/pull/702/files#r1502720374 But so far evmone does validation after 3860 charge and before hashing charge Aha i see eofcreate allows modifying the aux_data not creating new code. It loads code from container, executes it and calls `RETURNCONTRACT` to fill aux_data? Yes, correct Does this mean that `container` in Eof body is in form of raw eof bytes or something else? How should i look at this Nested containers all must be valid EOF containers (recursive nature of validation ensures this) I missed that. It is a lot clearer now. Thanks! IIRC Subcontainers can actaully be short on data while a subcontainer, but must be full size when EOFCREATEed, so there is one (small) validation. This is so that a contract can DATALOADN to something not hard coded, such as a ERC-20 contract, and wait for it to show up as aux_data.

excerpts.author: draganrakita
excerpts.content:
Need some clarification on `txcreate` (create4) and `eofcreate` (create3).
1. Does `eofcreate` do any verification and when?
2. In txcreate `validates the initcode container and all its subcontainers recursively`. when is this done? And as txcreate has access to tx initcodes, does those get validated?

excerpts.author: gumb00
excerpts.content:
1. not EOF validation, because this code was already validated when factory contract was deployed.
2. this is done by TXCREATE instruction after loading initcontainer from transaction and charging EIP-3860 charge for it

excerpts.author: gumb00
excerpts.content:
There're some new thoughts about exact order of checks in TXCREATE https://github.com/ethereum/evmone/pull/702/files#r1502720374
But so far evmone does validation after 3860 charge and before hashing charge

excerpts.author: draganrakita
excerpts.content: Aha i see eofcreate allows modifying the aux_data not creating new code. It loads code from container, executes it and calls `RETURNCONTRACT` to fill aux_data?

excerpts.author: draganrakita
excerpts.content: Does this mean that `container` in Eof body is in form of raw eof bytes or something else? How should i look at this

excerpts.author: gumb00
excerpts.content: Nested containers all must be valid EOF containers
